about: What the timing harness (scripts/tests/plan_dashboard_harness.py) and the dashboard agree on. The harness reads this file and never imports the dashboard; the dashboard's events test and the harness tests read it too.

snapshot.layout: one file with one section per row selection

schema.body_sha256: sha256 of the sections body; a mismatch makes the file absent

snapshot.written_on: a clean exit, the quit key or SIGTERM: the dashboard writes the snapshot atomically (temporary name, then rename), emits snapshot_written, then exits
snapshot.harness_save_run: the harness ends a save run with SIGTERM and copies the snapshot only after snapshot_written; a run that emits no snapshot_written is a failed save run
snapshot.tmux_listing: the tmux window listing is re-listed on every cycle and is never served from the snapshot

screen.wait_column: the cell under the header 'wait', from its header offset to the next header's offset

old_marking.meaning: the value on screen came from the snapshot and the live check has not replaced it yet

unread_marking.meaning: the figure has not been read yet

screen.confirmed_row: a row whose wait cell holds neither '~' nor '?'
screen.first_rows: the first moment a line under the header carries a live-state word (active, idle, stale, done) in the 'live' column

events.transport: JSON lines {ev, t_ns, ...payload} written to the named pipe PATH under tui --events PATH (not stderr: Textual draws on fd 2); t_ns is time.monotonic_ns()

payload.from_snapshot: bool, false in the old code

payload.applied: [path...] in the new code, 'all' in the old code

mark_confirmed.rule: emitted only after the live check read that task's changed sources; applied lists every source of that task read so far

payload.applied: [path...] in the new code, 'all' in the old code
[path...] in the new code, 'all' in the old code

first_screen_confirmed.rule: every row of the first screen shows a value the live check confirmed

last_old_cleared.rule: the last row of the whole table lost its old marking

events.old_code: with every mark read live, the old code emits rows_painted{from_snapshot:false}, mark_painted and mark_confirmed{applied:'all'} for each task at the same moment, live_check_end{applied:'all'}, cycle_start and cycle_end{applied:'all'}

source_to_task.state: the task named in the state file
source_to_task.binding: the tasks its harness session drives (the binding file's driven list)
source_to_task.transcript: the tasks its harness session drives (the binding file's driven list), plus the task of the same name
